description: Which exam dates on MHLW's list page of national qualification exams changed, appeared or left the list since a date (this service's own record of page versions; MHLW keeps none)? Each change has before and after as published and the time this service first read it. Optional exam and change_type filters. Free window: last 30 days.

change_type.description: Optional filter: exam_added, exam_reappeared, exam_removed, exam_details_changed, event_added, event_date_changed, event_details_changed, event_removed

exam.description: Optional: exam_id or exact exam name

since.description: ISO 8601 date or date-time with time zone, e.g. 2026-10-01 or 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z

name: exam_schedule_changes

changes.description: Changes observed by this service between versions of the list page, oldest first.

history_window.description: Free history window applied to this answer.

clamped.description: true when requested_since was earlier than the free window and the answer covers only the window.

free_days.description: Days of recorded history served free of charge.

older_history.description: Status of recorded history older than the free window.

requested_since.description: The since you asked for (normalized to ISO 8601).

served_since.description: The since actually applied: requested_since, or the start of the free window if requested_since was earlier.

official_check.description: Read first: dates as published on MHLW's list page at retrieved_at; confirm on the official exam page before applying.

provenance.description: Freshness receipts for every upstream source used.

items.description: Freshness receipt for one upstream source.

fetch_status.description: found / empty / stale / unavailable / unsupported (see catalog fetch_status_values).

retrieved_at.description: When this service retrieved the upstream data (null if unknown).

source.description: Publisher and URL of the upstream document or dataset.

upstream_updated_at.description: Update time stated by the upstream, or null when it states none.

source.description: Where the answer comes from: MHLW's list page, when this service last read it, and the page version used.

retrieved_at.description: When this service last read MHLW's list page successfully.

terms.description: URL of the terms of service.

tracking_since.description: When this service first read the list page. Changes before it were not observed.

title: Japanese national exam schedule changes
